newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-REQUIREMENTS FOR OFFICIAL LIST SHARES.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-REQUIREMENTS FOR OFFICIAL LIST SHARES.

text.p: As the stock exchange launches its official trading list on Monday, it gave the following details of the requirements that companies on the list need to fulfill:
So far, there are are four official list shares: Hermis Bank, Vilnius Bank, Rokishkis Cheese and Medienos Plaushas.
- the securities shall be subject to public trading and shall be registered with the securities commission.
- the securities shall be fully redeemed, without any restrictions on the transfer of ownership, granting the same rights to their owners.
- the issuer shall have authorised capital in excess of 5 million litas and total nominal value of one issue shall be at least one million litas.

- the current ratio of assets and liabilities calculated according to the issuer's annual financial statement shall be no less than two (provided that the issuer is neither a commercial bank nor an investment company).
- the capital adequacy ratio calculated according to the issuer's annual financial statement shall exceed 13 percent (provided that the issuer is a commercial bank).

- the issuer's earnings per share (net profit - preference share dividend claim/number of ordinary shares) calculated according to the annual financial statement will be no less than 5 percent of its nominal value.
- the stock ownership distribution shall enure stock liquidity.
- financial information provided in the annual prospectus
- financial statements, prepared by the standardised requirements of the securities commission, shall be audited by an international auditor.
- all issuers whose securities are admitted to the official list are obliged to submit quarterly financial statements.
